momentum.rule: Paper only. If NIFTY moves ±0.5% from 09:15 to 10:15, buy 1 lot of the ATM call/put that way at the real NSE price (not on expiry day, premium up to Rs 15,000). Stop -30%, cost after +20%, trail from +40%, book +60%, else close 15:15. Costs Rs 150 per trade.
